snippet.title: Overwatch Animated Short | “Reign of Talon”
snippet.description:
It’s Vendetta vs. Doomfist in the fight for control of Talon.

Witness the rise of a new Talon empire in our newest animated short, ’Reign of Talon.’

The story continues in Season 1: Conquest with 5 new Heroes, Vendetta’s arrival to Stadium, new Sub-Role Passives, and so much more launching on Feb 10.

Overwatch is free to play for everyone on console & PC!
